specificationName: Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment

instructionalToFunctional.instructionalRequirement: SurrealDB must have all required tables, indexes, and permissions created automatically on fresh deployment. The initSchema Kubernetes Job must run successfully as a post-install/post-upgrade helm hook to initialize database schema without manual intervention.
instructionalToFunctional.rootCauseIdentified: Namespace/database configuration mismatch - SurrealDB server started without --ns/--db args while init-schema Job connected with specific namespace/database (metabob/production)
functionalImplementation: Added --ns and --db args to SurrealDB Deployment template
Added --ns and --db args to SurrealDB StatefulSet template

dataFlowTransformation.before: helmfile apply → SurrealDB (no namespace/database args) → init-schema Job SKIPPED (enabled=false) → RPC API starts → Unknown schema state
dataFlowTransformation.after: helmfile apply → SurrealDB (WITH namespace/database args) → init-schema Job RUNS (post-install hook) → Creates 13 tables + 8 indexes → RPC API starts → Guaranteed schema state

guarantees.before: NONE - Database schema state unknown on fresh deployment
guarantees.after: FULL - 13 tables + 8 indexes guaranteed before RPC API starts

upstreamComponents.reason: database.namespace and database.name already existed in values.yaml

downstreamComponents.reason: All components already reference correct configuration values

crossCuttingConcerns.evidence: All SurrealDB clients reference same values from values.yaml

commitDetails.message: feat(schema): Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment

instructions.step4: kubectl get jobs -n metabob | grep init-schema
instructions.expectedResult: Job completes successfully, logs show '✅ 13/13 tables with PERMISSIONS FULL'

details.configurationRisk: Additive changes only - existing functionality unaffected
details.deploymentRisk: Requires fresh deployment (helmfile destroy && apply) - cluster downtime
details.rollbackRisk: Git history preserved - easy rollback with git revert

nextSteps.immediate: Deploy to cluster to complete runtime validation
followUp: Monitor init-schema Job logs on first deployment
Verify Job completion: kubectl get jobs -n metabob
Verify schema created: kubectl logs job/surrealdb-init-schema

impulseId: final-Database Schema Initialization - Automatic Schema Creation on Fresh Deployment
